name: animated-faq
title: Animated FAQ
description: Accessible accordion-style FAQ component with smooth GSAP animations

changelog.summary: Updated accordion behavior and documented reduced-motion support.

props.name: allowMultiple
props.description: Lets more than one FAQ answer stay open at once.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Shows or hides the FAQ trigger icon.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Side where the trigger icon is rendered.

props.name: iconMode
props.description: Chevron rotation style used by the trigger icon.
